capabilities: Append copied text with a timestamp to the active note
Auto-monitor the clipboard on desktop so copies save automatically
Save the clipboard manually via a command on mobile
Configure the separator text and timestamp toggle in settings
extras: Mobile saving requires granting clipboard permission on first use; command names are listed in both Chinese and English, and the README notes Obsidian mobile lacks system-level clipboard monitoring.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to automatically capture text you copy elsewhere into the note you have open.
summary: Clipboard capture tool that appends system clipboard content with a timestamp to the currently open Markdown note.
